texts.preamble: Vinod Kumar Jain vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 29 April, 2020 Author: Rajendra Kumar Srivastava Bench: Rajendra Kumar Srivastava 1 Crr-483-2020 The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh Crr-483-2020 (Vinod Kumar Jain Vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh) 4 Jabalpur, Dated : 29-04-2020
texts.facts: Prosecution case in short is that on 3.3.2012 at about 1.00 Noon, Food Inspector rushed to a Hotel situated at Bus Stand Shahnager for conducting inspection wherein the applicant Vinod Kumar Jain was found running the Hotel. In the said Hotel in a tray, 05 Kg. flour Ladoos (Besan Ke Laddu) were kept which was suspected, thereafter Food Inspector took sample of the same and sent for FSL Examination of public Analyst in which the same was found adulterated, thereafter crime was registered against the applicant.
texts.arguments: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is in jail since 13.03.2020. Independent witnesses did not support the case of prosecution. Mandatory provisions of the Act did not comply with in this case. He also submits that there are many contradictions, omissions and 2 CRR-483-2020 improvements in the version of the prosecution witnesses. He further submits that there is fair chance to succeed in the case. Learned counsel for applicant submits that no case is Vinod Kumar Jain vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 29 April, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/58002934/ 1 made out against the applicant. In support of his contention he cited a judgment passed in M.Cr.C. No. 10677/2016 (Dayachand Vs. State of M.P.). The revision is of the year 2020 and final hearing of this revision will take time. If the applicant is not released on bail, purpose of filing this application will be frustrated.
